notes.title: Fahrenheit: Indigo Prophecy Remastered is only $1.99! Sell some trading cards and pick it up!
notes.content:
Fahrenheit: Indigo Prophecy Remastered is on sale for 80% off! 

Don’t forget, you can always buy a gift copy for a friend too!

[h1] 100% the story! [/h1]
Less than 5% of Steam users have 100%ed all achievements, and we know you can do better. Take a look at 3xA'Lucky’s [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=686660463]guide[/url] and get to work. We want to see this number surpass 10%!

[h1] Have you written a review yet? Why not? [/h1]
Please take a moment to write a review on Steam! It helps us a lot!
